title: Do Employee Interests Affect Target Board Decisions About Acquisition Offers? Evidence from Changes in Unemployment Insurance
eligible_reason: The treatment in every table is continuous: ui_level = target-state maximum unemployment insurance benefit level (in thousands of dollars), entered linearly (Tables 2-7) or interacted with a post indicator at the deal level (Table 8), with state-level (log_gdp, elect, t_unemp) and firm-level time-varying controls and sic2 x year, sic2 x state and region x year fixed effects. The only binary event design is Figure 2 (reghdfe acquisition c.treat#c.(year1-year3 year5-year9) + controls, absorb(fipscounty#sich datayear)), an event-study plot around 'large UI rise' events with time-varying controls; its data file (data_figure2) is not shipped and the construction of treat / the event window cannot be verified. The main design therefore fails the binary-treatment rule; Figure 2 would at most be a near-miss (controls in the single reported specification).
design_notes: Firm-year panel of potential targets, 1986-2018 (acquisition = 1 if the firm receives an acquisition offer). Table 2 (do_all_tables.do line 33): reghdfe acquisition ui_level [log_gdp elect t_unemp] roa xrd1 lev sale_gr fix_asset m_b log_market log_age, a(sic2#datayear sic2#state1 region1#datayear) vce(cluster state1), with and without 'disperse' firms. Table 3: high/low unionization splits and c.high_ind##c.ui_level. Table 4: deal characteristics on ui_level with a(state1 datayear). Table 5: ui_level x constituency-statute and other antitakeover-law indicators, a(sic2#state1 sic2#datayear incorp1). Table 6: interactions with short-term IO, labor intensity, population, social capital. Table 7: female independent directors splits. Table 8: total_work (log combined employees) on c.ui_level##c.post, a(deal_number sic2#datayear), cluster deal_number. Figure 2: event-study coefficients for years -4..+4 around large UI rises (omitted -1), plotted from Figure2_plot.xlsx (coefficients 0.003, -0.009, -0.005, 0, 0.0003, 0.016, 0.011, 0.016, 0.016).
estimators_reported: twfe_continuous_treatment_with_controls (ui_level; sic2 x year, sic2 x state, region x year FE)
binary_event_study_with_controls (Figure 2 only; large UI rise events; county x industry FE and year FE)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Not applicable for the continuous main design. Large UI rises (Figure 2) occur in different states and years, but the event definition and window handling are not recoverable from the package.
